description:
Advances: ancora.review

Ready-for: implement

Problem:
`mix spec.review --base <ref>` raises FunctionClauseError in Access.get/3 when the base commit has no `.spec/specs` directory. Review builds `base_index = Index.build(base_root, index_opts)` (lib/ancora/review.ex:75). For that base it returns `{:error, ".spec/specs directory not found ..."}`, and ownership_changes/2 (called at :134) then reads `base["subjects"]` from the tuple (:146). `mix spec.check` passes on the same base, because the gate treats an added subject against an empty base set (ancora.gate.new_subject_self_clears). Every adopter's first PR has such a base, so the review artifact fails on the adoption PR itself.

Reproduction with 1.3.0: in ChapterSpot/tsql_parser at 0542f06, `mix spec.review --base 410b084 --output /tmp/r.html` raises, and `mix spec.check --base 410b084` prints `spec.check result=pass`. 410b084 is the last commit before `.spec/` was added. tsql_parser's CI now skips only that optional HTML step for this case.

Contract it breaks: ancora.review.view_model_builder (Review.build/2 returns {:ok, view}) and ancora.decision.no_execution_no_state (a missing corpus is an environment failure represented as data, never a raise).

Deliverable:
Review treats a base with no spec workspace as an empty base index, the same model the gate uses, and renders the artifact with every HEAD subject as new. A base whose workspace exists but fails to parse keeps its current handling.

Verification:
- Tests to pass: mix test, including a new tagged test in test/ancora/review_test.exs under ancora.review.view_model_builder.
- Behaviors to demonstrate: on a fixture repo whose base commit has no .spec/ and whose HEAD adds one subject, Ancora.Review.build/2 returns {:ok, view}, the subject shows its requirements as added, and the verdict chip matches `mix spec.check` for the same base.
- The real CLI on that fixture exits 0 and writes the HTML file, with no stack trace on stderr.
- Verification cadence: mix test while iterating; mix spec.check --base origin/main and the full check alias before closing.

Out of Scope (files):
- lib/ancora/derive/**
- lib/ancora/gate/**, lib/ancora/gate.ex
Allowed touches:
- lib/ancora/review.ex, lib/ancora/review/**
- test/ancora/review_test.exs, test/ancora/review/**, test/support/**
- .spec/specs/ancora.review.spec.md (a scenario for the missing-base case), .spec/decisions/**
- Any .spec/specs/<subject>.spec.md that spec.check names in a derived finding caused by this diff (acknowledgment edits only)

Out of Scope (intent):
- No change to how the gate handles the same base.
- ancora-90t (preflight ignores --spec-dir at HEAD) stays separate.
- ancora-d16.6 (review discards derivation errors) stays separate.

Merge gate:
- [ ] mix test green
- [ ] mix spec.check --base origin/main passes
- [ ] The reproduction above renders an artifact
title: [BUG] spec.review crashes when the base predates the spec workspace
